story: Alex stood frozen at the edge of the darkened hallway, his breath catching in his throat as a faint creak echoed from the room ahead. His heart hammered against his ribs like a trapped bird, each beat sending a jolt of cold electricity down his spine. He clutched the doorknob so tightly his knuckles turned white, the metal biting into his palm yet offering no comfort. The shadows seemed to stretch and twist, forming shapes that danced just beyond the reach of the dim streetlight filtering through the window. Every instinct screamed at him to run, to flee back to the safety of the street, but his feet remained rooted to the floorboards.

Alex stood frozen in the center of the dimly lit hallway, his breath catching sharply in his throat as a heavy, rhythmic thud echoed from the room behind him. His fingers trembled violently against the cool brass doorknob, slick with sweat, making it nearly impossible to maintain a secure grip on the cold metal surface. Every instinct screamed at him to run, yet his legs felt like lead, anchored firmly to the floor by an invisible, crushing weight that pinned him in place. The shadows seemed to stretch and twist into grotesque shapes, closing in around him as the sound grew louder, more deliberate, and impossibly close. He squeezed his eyes shut, praying for silence that never came.

Alex stood frozen in the dimly lit hallway, his breath catching in his throat as a floorboard creaked ominously above. He pressed his back against the cold, unyielding wall, his heart hammering against his ribs like a trapped bird desperate for escape. Every shadow seemed to stretch and twist into menacing shapes, and the silence felt heavy, suffocating, and thick with unspoken danger. He held his phone tightly, his thumb hovering over the emergency contact number, trembling slightly from the sheer intensity of his anticipation. The air grew colder, prickling the fine hairs on his arms, and he realized with a sinking feeling in his stomach that he was entirely alone in the dark.
